estimand.name: daily_cross_sectional_qlike
estimand.metric: cross-sectional QLIKE (mean of per-coin QLIKE losses across coins each day)
estimand.qlike: qlike(y, yhat) = y/yhat - log(y/yhat) - 1, lower is better
estimand.note: QLike is a loss: C2 improves when mean_daily_cross_sectional_qlike_C2 < mean_daily_cross_sectional_qlike_B1, i.e. paired diff (C2-B1) < 0.

universe.source_family: combined metpie (2025-03-22..2025-05-25) + ironflow (2025-05-25..2026-10-31) Hyperliquid observed liquidation events

features.note: All features are causal (past-only as-of joins) at the event->daily aggregation grain. Funding features are the last funding timestamp <= event; RV features are 4h-candle rolling std over past bars.

train.blocks: panel-origin expanding-window train; block1 train window is empty (panel starts 2025-03-22) so block 1 is train-limited by design

splits.note: Test blocks are non-overlapping 30d blocks; 2 pristine metpie blocks never tested for this estimand + 1 estimand-novel ironflow block. Expanding-window walk-forward: fit on data <= block_start - 7d, evaluate the block.

pass_conditions: block_bootstrap 95% CI hi < 0 for paired diff (C2-B1) on primary QLIKE (excludes zero in favorable direction)
gate.null_handling: Record NOT_MET honestly; do not retune thresholds; install next materially different heavy cell if NOT_MET.
